figures.title: This paper in the 13 components, against the field
figures.subtitle: Each box: what this paper does, then common practice across all sensors and how many ledger papers share it.
figures.caption: Verdicts compare the paper's choice for each component with common practice across 8,995 ledger entries on any sensor (silent speech, brain-to-text, lip reading).

M01.note: Inherited corpus; sampling seed and subset not reported.

M02.note: No audio or text-derived auxiliary target.

M03.note: DC-TCN training recipe of [@ma2022training] without mixup.

choice: RGB mouth crops; 20 derived lip landmarks
M05.note: Landmarks are a derived stream, not a new sensor; 96 x 96 mouth crops with 88 x 88 random or centre crop, as in the standard pipeline.

choice: Pixel ResNet-18 plus three-graph landmark GCN, staged fusion
M06.note: Graph-plus-pixel fusion of 20 lip points already in [@liu2020lipgraph]; landmark stream in 64 studies (pattern match).

M11.note: Validation and test share the 20 held-out speakers, as the authors state (Sec. 4.1) following earlier LRW-ID settings.

choice: Acc / mAcc, one run; word boundary in code only
M12.note: No seeds, perturbation magnitudes or word-boundary condition stated.

M13.note: Parameters up from 52.55M; no latency or device test; authors concede edge-deployment cost.
